title: IDENTIFYING AND MITIGATING VULNERABILITIES IN LLM-INTEGRATED APPLICATIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Targeted Attack Success Rate (TSR) by injecting malicious system or user prompts (via insider or outsider threats) to force the LLM to exhibit a targeted preference for a specific product over another in an online shopping scenario. The presence of this commercial bias is evaluated using both human review (HumanEval) and an automated LLM-based judge (GPT-auto).
